statement: Pinned rnconrad Wii Remote emulator performs a read/write boundary check using offset + size > 0x16FF after masking the offset to 16 bits. For a one-byte request at 0x16FF this emulator returns an invalid-address error, although its comment describes 0x16FF as the last address. This establishes a probable software off-by-one in this independent implementation, not a physical EEPROM boundary.

applicability.revision: Historical software emulator; physical hardware variant not established
applicability.scope: Source lines 241-249 and 299-307; legacy device-side emulator boundary vs the unverified physical 0x1700-byte region. Do not emulate a suspected bug without separate evidence.
